## 4. Hypothesized Reason for Inactivity
The gap spans December 2022 – February 2023, which is a **winter holiday
period** for most contributors. The pre-gap themes include Release,
suggesting the project had just cut a release and contributors took a
break before starting the next development cycle.

## 5. Recovery
- **Did it recover?** Yes
- **Why did it recover?** Normal post-release development resumed in
  February 2023 with new feature work.
- **Who drove the recovery?** Core Stan developers (same maintainers).

## 6. Current Status
- **Current status:** **Active** (last commit ~9 hours ago)
- **Recent themes (last 10 commits):** Feature development:Bug fixes

## 7. Summary
bayesplot is a well-maintained R package with only one notable 3-month
gap, coinciding with the December 2022 holiday period immediately after a
release. Development resumed normally in early 2023 and continues at high
velocity through 2025. The project is Active.
